# query

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
query name, label
```

A question an actor may ask of a read model; a capability, like a command.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-query-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The query's name. |
| <a id="contract-query-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What the business calls it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-query-reads"></a>`reads` | `atom` | yes |  | The read model it reads. |
| <a id="contract-query-by"></a>`by` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The actors who may ask it. |
| <a id="contract-query-returns"></a>`returns` | `:many \| :one` |  | `:many` | Rows or one row. |
| <a id="contract-query-scope"></a>`scope` | `atom` |  |  | The row field a grant narrows the answer to: a parameter and a scope of every actor. |
| <a id="contract-query-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the query comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`param`](#contract-query-param), [`constraint`](#contract-query-constraint).
